definitions.ask: Should the section include the probe follow-ups and the one-line rules strip below the answer?
definitions.why: The "laid off?" probe is where a live answer most often goes wrong, so it should be one glance away.

choices.label: Answer, one-liner, four probe follow-ups, a rules strip, and sources (about 400 words)
Only the answer, the one-liner, and sources (about 225 words); the playbook keeps everything else

definitions.ask: Should the follow-ups commit to "sase stays my personal toolkit on my own time; the job gets my working hours"?
definitions.why: Research ranks it the top flight-risk counter; it sets a boundary, not abandonment.

choices.label: Keep that follow-up; it states a real boundary you will repeat word for word in every interview
Drop that follow-up until you have decided what sase's future is after a hire
